findings.note: [tool.setuptools.package-data] declares pz_save_manager = ["templates/*.html"]; gui.py uses Flask(__name__, template_folder="templates") and render_template("index.html"); templates/index.html exists in the package tree.
_render_page now calls render_template("index.html", ...) which uses Jinja's cached loader; the per-request read_text/render_template_string was removed.
_manager() raises RuntimeError when no WatcherManager is injected; get_manager import and global-singleton fallback removed, matching gui.py fail-closed behavior.
ConfigStore tracks (st_mtime_ns, st_size) signature; _load reloads when the signature differs, so external edits and cross-instance writes are picked up.
No module-level app = create_app(); run_gui builds a fresh app via create_app and accepts a manager parameter; cli.py:164 passes ctx.obj['manager'] so the CLI-created manager is used.
Rename captures manager.watcher_settings(live_save) (debounce, cooldown, saves_root, backups_root) and re-registers the renamed save with those same settings.
CSRF check uses secrets.compare_digest(token, CSRF_TOKEN) for constant-time comparison.
_coerce enforces ranges: debounce_seconds 0-3600, backup_cooldown_minutes 0-1440, max_auto_backups 0-999, port 1-65535; out-of-range values raise ValueError before persistence.
create_app reads config_store.get('auto_start_watcher') and calls start_watching_saves(), the same helper used by the manual API toggle.
/health aborts 403 when request.remote_addr is not loopback (and on parse failure), preventing LAN information disclosure under gui --host 0.0.0.0.

os._exit removed; SaveWatcher.wait_idle and WatcherManager.stop(timeout) wait for in-progress backups; api_shutdown uses werkzeug.server.shutdown when available, falling back to _thread.interrupt_main().

summary: All 11 findings from the original review are RESOLVED, verified against the actual source rather than the developer's diffs. The high-severity packaging regression is fixed: package-data is declared, Flask resolves the template via its package loader, and templates/index.html is present. The medium findings (per-request template recompile, fail-closed manager lookup, config cache invalidation, completed DI with no import-time app) and all low findings (rename watcher settings, constant-time CSRF, numeric range validation, auto_start_watcher wired, /health loopback gating, graceful shutdown without os._exit) are all addressed in code. APPROVE.
